name: ACI 318-19 + ASCE 7-22
description: The US pack: ASCE/SEI 7-22 loads (combinations Sec 2.3-2.4, live loads and reduction Ch 4, seismic Ch 11-12 from the site's mapped spectral values, wind Ch 26-30, roof snow Ch 7) and ACI 318-19 structural concrete: strength reduction by strain (21.2), one-way shear with the size effect (22.5), two-way shear (22.6, with prestress 22.6.5.5), deflection with the 2019 effective inertia (24.2.3.5), crack control (24.3), shrinkage steel 0.0018 (24.4), development with the grade factor, the 2019 hooked and headed bar lengths (25.4), laps (25.5), columns (10), walls (11) and special walls (18.10: boundary elements by 1.5 du/hw, the amplified design shear, wall piers, coupling beams), special moment frame members and joints (18.6-18.8), slabs (8: direct design and equivalent frame), composite members (16.4), strut-and-tie (23). Structural steel by AISC 360-22 (LRFD, ASD selectable): members (Chapters D-H with the 2016+ effective width method for slender elements, Cv1 web shear, tees and HSS lateral-torsional buckling), connections (Chapter J values), stability (Chapter C, Appendix 7), composite members (Chapter I values) and AISC 341-22 seismic provisions (expected strengths, highly and moderately ductile width-thickness limits). Masonry: TMS 402-22 allowable stress design (Chapter 8, the default method) and strength design (Chapter 9, a wall type's masonry method 'strength'). Timber: NDS 2018 reference design values of sawn lumber and glulam with their adjustment factors (CD, CM, Ct, CF, Cfu, Ci, Cr, CV, CL, CP, Cb), ASD or LRFD (KF, φ, λ), bolts and nails by the yield limit equations. Steel also: built-up members (E6), stability bracing (Appendix 6), ponding (Appendix 2), tension field stiffeners (G2.3), HSS connections (Chapter K), fatigue (Appendix 3) and the AISC 341-22 moment frame connections, panel zones, links, BRBF, SPSW and composite rules. Cold-formed lipped C and Z members by AISI S100-16 and steel members in fire by AISC 360-22 Appendix 4 (simple method). Foundations (alpha 9 C12): IBC 2021 presumptive load-bearing values (Table 1806.2), the ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4 combinations for the soil pressure, IBC depths and factors of safety, ACI 336.2R raft stiffness; anchors by ACI 318-19 Chapter 17; RC water tanks by ACI 350-06 (service steel stress, shrinkage steel, cover); member deflection limits by IBC 2021 Table 1604.3. Where these codes give no value (settlement limits, subgrade moduli, pile static methods, machine foundations) the default pack's value is kept and named SAEngine practice. The masonry empirical and seismic rules fall back to the pack it extends (BNBC 2020), and the report names them. Every value has its clause in VERIFY.md, to be checked against the printed standards. Special members (alpha 9 L7): open-web steel joists and joist girders by SJI 100-2020 / SJI 200 rules on the AISC 360-22 member checks (the catalogue load tables are project data), castellated and cellular beams by AISC Design Guide 31, structural glass by ASTM E1300 (load resistance, approximated), tensile membranes and cable nets (SAEngine practice) and concrete-filled composite plate shear walls by AISC 341-22 H7 / AISC 360-22 Chapter I. Aluminium by the Aluminum Design Manual is not covered.

sources.title: Minimum Design Loads and Associated Criteria for Buildings and Other Structures (ASCE/SEI 7-22)
Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete (ACI 318-19)
Seismic Provisions for Structural Steel Buildings (ANSI/AISC 341-22)
Building Code Requirements for Masonry Structures (TMS 402-22)
National Design Specification for Wood Construction (ANSI/AWC NDS-2018) with its Supplement
North American Specification for the Design of Cold-Formed Steel Structural Members (AISI S100-16)
Code Requirements for Environmental Engineering Concrete Structures (ACI 350-06)
Suggested Analysis and Design Procedures for Combined Footings and Mats (ACI 336.2R-88), a report
Seismic Evaluation and Retrofit of Existing Buildings (ASCE/SEI 41-17)
Improvement of Nonlinear Static Seismic Analysis Procedures (FEMA 440)

isolation: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 17 (seismically isolated structures: one MCER level with the upper and lower bound properties, ELF, response spectrum and response history criteria, property modification factors, prototype tests)
dampers: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 18 (structures with damping systems: effective damping, the damped equivalent lateral force with the fundamental and residual modes, the devices at the MCER)
hazardLookup: ASCE/SEI 7-22 Sec 11.4 (mapped values by the USGS Seismic Design Web Services, asce7-22 endpoint; opt-in online lookup, alpha 9 C22)
existing: ASCE/SEI 41-17 (assessment, knowledge factor, m-factors, Tier 1 checklist topics) and ACI 440.2R-17 (FRP); jackets by the EN 1998-3 A.4.2.2 factors (SAEngine practice)
excavationSupport: PTI DC35.1 and FHWA GEC No. 4 for ground anchors (SAEngine practice; IBC 2021 and ASCE 7-22 give no method for excavation support)
locations: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.4.2, 26.5.1, 7.2: site values from the ASCE Hazard Tool
designClauses: ACI 318-19, ASCE 7-22 and AISC 360-22: the clause references of the concrete and steel member design checks
citations: ACI 318-19: the concrete clause references of the report, worksheets and drawings
foundations: IBC 2021 Chapter 18 (presumptive values Table 1806.2, retaining walls 1807.2.3, depths 1809.4, piles 1810.3.3) with the ASCE 7-22 Sec 2.4 combinations; ACI 318-19 Chapter 23 (strut-and-tie); ACI 336.2R rafts; SAEngine practice where these give no value
steel: AISC 360-22 Chapters B-K and Appendices 2 and 6: φ and Ω, member methods (built-up members E6), bolts, welds and connection values (HSS connections Chapter K), ponding, stability bracing
steelSeismic: AISC 341-22 Chapters A-K: moment frames E1-E4 (with AISC 358 for the prequalified connections), braced frames F1-F4, special plate shear walls F5, composite members and walls
composite: AISC 360-22 Chapter I (where revised; the rest BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 13)
masonry: TMS 402-22 Chapter 8 (allowable stress design, the default method) and Chapter 9 (strength design); the empirical and seismic rules BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 7
timber: NDS 2018 Chapters 2-5, 11-12 and Appendix N: reference design values (Supplement Tables 4A, 4D, 5A) and adjustment factors, ASD and LRFD; dowel-type fasteners
coldFormed: AISI S100-16 North American Specification for the Design of Cold-Formed Steel Structural Members
serviceability: IBC 2021 Table 1604.3 (member deflections); ASCE 7-22 Appendix C commentary (drift and sway, SAEngine practice)
plumbing: ACI 350-06 (the RC water tanks only; the building services are the default pack's)
pushover: ASCE/SEI 41-17 Ch 7 (nonlinear static procedure, target displacement), Ch 9-10 (hinges and acceptance); FEMA 440 equivalent linearization (selectable)
nonlinearHistory: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 16 (nonlinear response history: records, MCER target, maximum-direction scaling or matching, drift 1.5x, ASCE 41 hinges, force-controlled actions)
floorVibration: AISC Design Guide 11 (2nd ed.) for floors on steel beams; CCIP-016 / SCI P354 for concrete floors (SAEngine practice where ASCE 7-22 Appendix C gives no method)
windComfort: ASCE/SEI 7-22 Appendix C and Commentary C26.11 (along-wind peak acceleration)

basis.steel: AISC 360-22 (LRFD; ASD selectable; Appendix 4 fire), AISC 341-22, AISI S100-16 (cold-formed)
basis.method: Strength design (LRFD); timber NDS 2018 and masonry TMS 402-22 by allowable stresses (ASD) unless chosen otherwise
